newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia PM to make statement on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia PM to make statement on Wednesday.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard will make a statement in parliament about the first nine months of the Liberal-National government on Wednesday, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.

"He (Howard) said he would be making a statement to the House (of Representatives) tomorrow, a prime ministerial report to the nation in which he would be looking back over the first period of the government in office and projecting ahead to next year," the spokesman told reporters.
The Liberal-National coalition ousted the former Labor government in the March 2 election.
